doan_van.ten: Truyện — Bị ốm và lời khuyên
doan_van.noi_dung:
Last Monday morning, I woke up with a terrible headache and a sore throat. I tried to drink some warm water, but my throat was very painful. By midday, I had a high fever and a bad cough as well. I told my manager at work that I did not feel well. She looked at me and said I had better go home immediately. She also suggested that I should see a doctor soon because my symptoms sounded like the flu.

When I got home, I called the local clinic because I wanted to make an appointment. The receptionist asked what was wrong and gave me a time to visit later that afternoon. At the clinic, the doctor checked my temperature and examined my throat. The doctor said that I needed to rest for a few days and take some medicine. He gave me a prescription and advised me to drink plenty of warm fluids. In addition, he warned that I should not eat so much sugar while recovering.

My friend Lan called me later and asked why I did not take a day off for the rest of the week. I followed her advice and stayed in bed to recover quickly. Now, I feel healthy again and I try to do light exercise every day.

phat_am:
- **stomach** /ˈstʌmək/ — “ch” đọc là **/k/**, không phải /tʃ/.
- **cough** /kɒf/ — “gh” đọc là **/f/**. So sánh: though /ðəʊ/, through /θruː/, enough /ɪˈnʌf/ — cùng “gh” nhưng đọc khác nhau hoàn toàn.
- **medicine** /ˈmedsn/ — 2 âm tiết trong Anh-Anh, nuốt chữ “i”.
luu_y:
**① Cách nói bệnh — 3 kiểu, dùng sai là lộ ngay:**

- **have a** + bệnh: have a headache, have a cold, have a fever
- **have** (không mạo từ) với bệnh không đếm được: have flu, have toothache (Anh-Anh)
- **My … hurts**: My back hurts. / My throat hurts.

> ❌ I am headache. ❌ I have headache. → ✅ I **have a** headache.

**② should / shouldn’t = lời khuyên (nên/không nên).** Sau should → **V nguyên thể**, không “to”.
❌ You should to rest. ❌ He should rests. → ✅ You should rest.

**③ Ba cách khuyên, mức độ tăng dần:**

|Cấu trúc          |Mức độ                    |Ví dụ                     |
|------------------|--------------------------|--------------------------|
|Why don’t you + V?|gợi ý nhẹ                 |Why don’t you rest?       |
|You should + V    |khuyên bình thường        |You should rest.          |
|You’d better + V  |khuyên mạnh, có ý cảnh báo|You’d better see a doctor.|


> **had better** viết tắt là ‘d better, sau nó là **V nguyên thể**: ❌ You’d better to go.

**④ “sick” vs “ill”:**

- Anh-Anh: **ill** = ốm · **sick** = buồn nôn (*I feel sick* = tôi buồn nôn)
- Anh-Mỹ: **sick** = ốm nói chung

> Nếu học Anh-Anh, nói “I’m sick” có thể bị hiểu là “tôi sắp nôn”.

**⑤ medicine không đếm được** — ❌ two medicines → ✅ **some medicine** / two **types of** medicine.

**⑥ pain (danh từ) vs painful (tính từ) vs hurt (động từ):**
*I have a pain in my back. · My back is painful. · My back hurts.*
meo:
- Bệnh liên quan đến đau thường có đuôi **-ache** /eɪk/: headache, backache, toothache, stomachache.
- **should = “nên”** — dịch thẳng sang tiếng Việt là dùng đúng.
- Nhớ “’d better” mang sắc thái **cảnh báo**: dùng khi có hậu quả nếu không làm.

cau_hoi.de: She ____ a fever and a cough.

bai_tap.ten: Viết lời khuyên dùng should / shouldn’t

cau_hoi.de: Why don’t you (see / to see) a doctor?
You should to drink more water.
